% Definition of the class moderncv with some parameters. Font size 11pt, paper size A4, font sans
\documentclass[11pt, a4paper, sans]{moderncv}

% Includes all the necessary packages from packages.tex
\input{Setting/packages}

% Defines commands and parameters for modifying the included packages
\input{Setting/commands}

% Per-persona values (generated by the Makefile into the staged build tree):
%   \ResumeHeadline  — title line under the name
%   \ResumePhoto     — image path, or empty for no photo
% When built straight from the repo root (no staging), the defaults below apply.
\IfFileExists{headline.tex}{\input{headline.tex}}{}
\providecommand*{\ResumeHeadline}{Embedded Software Engineer}
\providecommand*{\ResumePhoto}{Images/profile.png}

% Beginning of document
\begin{document}
    \pagestyle{empty}

    % CV title with name, headline and (optional) photo
    \myCVtitle{Ehsan}{Shaghaei}{\ResumeHeadline}{\ResumePhoto}

    % Section order: generated includes.tex (from personas/<X>/order.txt) or the default order
    \IfFileExists{includes.tex}{\input{includes.tex}}{%
        \input{Content/PersonalInformation.tex}
        \input{Content/WorkExperience.tex}
        \input{Content/Skills.tex}
        \input{Content/Education.tex}
        \input{Content/AdditionalQualifications.tex}
        \input{Content/Projects.tex}
        \input{Content/Extra.tex}
    }
\end{document}
